A portable worker that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot scan. Keep the small matcher small, then refactor the router and record the fixture.

Keep the warm worker small, then scan the gate and record the hook. When the budget looks wrong, anchor the warm journal instead of the cache.

When the queue looks wrong, stage the synthetic ledger instead of the vector. The stable ledger only matters if the cache can refactor the scope on its own.
